name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash (Preview)
archDisplay: Post-trained MoE on the ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base pretrain (280B total / 14B active); 1M-token context; text only
note: Baidu's post-trained ERNIE 5.5 Flash, released as a preview: the API went live on Qianfan as `ernie-5.5-flash-preview` on Nov 10, 2026 and the launch post is dated Nov 11. It is the instruction-tuned model built on ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base (Nov 5), so `predecessor` is null rather than the base checkpoint. Baidu's English post says the weights 'will be open-sourced under Apache 2.0 soon' and its Chinese post (https://ernie.baidu.com/zh/release/ernie-5-5-flash-preview/) says before Nov 25, so openness is closed for now. Qianfan lists $0.28 input / $0.028 cache hit / $1.13 output per Mtok, and 1M max input and output. NO BENCHMARK ROWS YET: Baidu publishes its launch table only as an image, which could not be read from this environment, and the only text transcription is a third-party one (OrcaRouter). The scores will be filed once they can be checked against Baidu's own table.
